name: The Legend of Ogorets #3: Kikimora
source:
#3 is the adventure of Kikimora, a mutant creature tortured inside her own home wherever she rests for longer than a little whilst on a migratory path to escape danger she found inside a prison society. The only problem is, everywhere is dangerous for her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2577090/]Steam[/url]]
